feed.title: Free small-business calculators — tools on marisstella.dev
feed.subtitle: The 173 free, browser-only tools served directly from marisstella.dev — the newest 40 of them listed here, newest first. No account, no upload: every number stays on your own device. The full catalogue is larger and lives at tools.marisstella.dev.
feed.rights: Tools are MIT-licensed. They are estimates and records to act on, not professional advice.

entry.title: Which Job First? Free Pairwise Job Priority Ranker for Contractors
entry.summary: Paste your job list, answer a handful of this-or-that questions, and get a ranked work order. Free, private, runs entirely in your browser with no account.

entry.title: Security Camera Installation Bid Calculator — CCTV Storage
entry.summary: Price an IP security camera install from the drops, the cable, and the labour — and check the three things a camera bid gets wrong: days of recording the drives actually hold, PoE load against the switch budget, and runs past the 328 ft Ethernet limit.

entry.title: Shop Rate Calculator
entry.summary: Work out your real labor burden, your overhead rate on direct cost, and the hourly rate a trade job has to be sold at — from your own payroll, vehicles, office and materials. Free, private, and it fills in the burden and overhead fields on every bid calculator here.

entry.title: Appointment Deposit Calculator for Service Businesses

entry.title: Marketplace Fee Comparison — Which Channel Nets Most
entry.summary: Free side-by-side comparison of eBay, Etsy, Amazon, Walmart, TikTok Shop, and your own Shopify store on one item. Enter the price and your landed cost once and see net profit on every channel. Runs entirely in your browser.

entry.title: Sponsor Ready — free GitHub Sponsors readiness checklist
